=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7531-7556 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: code_ref() checks lookup_failed only inside `if candidate is None:`. If a newer linked run's GET fails, or its cached run-<id>.json is empty or malformed, an older eligible linked run or an issue-linked fallback is still chosen, and the function returns outcome=ok reason=retarget with retarget=True.
  WHY: This breaks the requirement "Fail closed to today's target when validation or lookup fails". The heal is retargeted on incomplete data and filed against a possibly wrong branch. The failed lookup is hidden in the log, and `partial reason=lookup_failed` can never be reached once a candidate exists. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Two reviewers add details: `_code_ref_cached_ids` treats an empty run-<id>.json as cached, so it is never fetched again, and test_intake_code_ref_without_evidence_pack_gets_at_most_three_runs asserts the retarget even though run 603 was unreadable.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7424-7425, 7549 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: code_ref_run_eligible() validates the run `path` as a bare repo path, and code_ref() compares it to the scope paths the same way, without first removing an `@ref` suffix. Other sites in the same file do remove it: _run_workflow_file and heal_scope_linked_workflow_paths at lines 9521-9523.
  WHY: `is_valid_repo_path` / `_REPO_PATH_RE` rejects `@`, so a child run whose path carries a suffix is never eligible and can never match the bare frozen scope. Code-ref routing then never retargets for that run. This fails closed and causes a missed route, not a wrong one. Severity is disputed: four reviewers rated it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, saying the GitHub REST run path is normally bare.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7429-7430 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: code_ref_run_eligible() treats every run whose status is not "completed" as eligible, whatever its conclusion. That includes queued, pending, waiting, requested and healthy in_progress runs.
  WHY: A child run on another branch that is still queued or running normally can be picked and retarget the heal before it has failed or stalled, and the log still says outcome=ok reason=retarget. The new test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:12128-12129 asserts that an in_progress run is retargeted. All four rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this and chose not to report it, reasoning that "still running" counts as stalled.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7531-7538 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When script_ref is set and a lookup also failed, the rendered `Code ran from` line (`unknown@<sha>` / `stable@unknown`) comes from script_ref, but the logged reason is overwritten to lookup_failed.
  WHY: The contractual log reason no longer matches where the body line came from, so operators cannot tell the line came from script_ref. This is cosmetic and does not affect routing; both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3774-3777 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `mkdir -p "${code_ref_dir}" || return 0` in _heal_code_ref_route returns early, after `rm -rf`, without setting CODE_REF_OUTCOME or CODE_REF_REASON, and skips the pure code-ref decision over the cached linked_runs/ and evidence_pack_api/ data.
  WHY: With the switch on, an unwritable RUNTIME_DIR is logged as `code_ref outcome=skipped reason=disabled`. That token is not in the agents.d/heal-code-ref.md vocabulary, and it hides the real failure. The suggested fix is to set partial/helper_failed before returning. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3783-3787 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In _heal_code_ref_route, a GET response that fails the identity jq check (matching id and repo) is removed with `rm -f "${code_ref_dir}/run-${code_ref_id}.json"`, without setting `code_ref_extra_args=(--lookup-failed)`.
  WHY: A misrouted or foreign response adds nothing to the candidates and is not counted as a failed lookup, so the decision is made silently with less data than budgeted. minimax_minimax-m3 rated this NIT on its own. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cite the same branch as part of their MAJOR lookup_failed finding on scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:4465-4493 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the code_ref retarget branch is missing, the fallback in the Route block calls `_branch_exists` a second time for the restored CODE_REF_PRIOR_TARGET.
  WHY: Each such fallback adds a GitHub REST GET beyond the documented budget ("0 with evidence-pack data; otherwise at most 3 run reads per report"). Both rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered it a rare path and chose not to report it.
- tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py:127; tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:62 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR's pre-push gate reports test_label_contract_and_reporter_skip() and test_checkout_workflows_are_all_classified() as failures caused by this change, but reading the code shows their assertions are still intact.
  WHY: The tests could not be run in this pass, so both gate failures are still unexplained and must be rerun on the PR head before merge. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 separately concluded that neither failure comes from this diff.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fail closed to today's target when validation or lookup fails, and log WORKFLOW_HEAL code_ref outcome=ok|skipped|partial reason=<r>."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py code_ref(), the retarget decision after a candidate is selected (lines 7539-7555); scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh _heal_code_ref_route(), the identity-check drop branch
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No code after candidate selection in code_ref() checks lookup_failed; it is applied only when no candidate exists (lines 7531-7537). The intake's identity-mismatch branch (lines 3783-3786) removes the response without passing --lookup-failed. Empty cached files and malformed `_code_ref_load` results still allow a retarget. The new intake test asserts retarget=main even though the newer linked run 603 failed to load, and no test covers lookup_failed=True together with an eligible candidate. agents.d/heal-code-ref.md lists lookup_failed as a partial reason that is unreachable once any candidate exists.
- requirement: "When P1 is off, make one GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id> per linked or issue-linked run, at most 3."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh::_heal_code_ref_route (P1-off branch) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::code_ref_requests
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: With P1 off, code_ref_requests gets ids only from failed-log links via select_linked_runs (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7365-7379; intake lines 3763-3772). code_ref_api_dir is left empty and no evidence-pack API directory reaches code-ref (intake lines 3760-3788 / 3790-3794). _cmd_code_ref loads args.evidence_api_dir only when it is present (line 10132), so code_ref's issue-linked branch (lines 7498-7530) never runs. agents.d/heal-code-ref.md says "issue-linked runs are not looked up with P1 off". Severity is disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT as a likely deliberate narrowing to stay within budget; the other four rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:code_ref() (`if candidate is None: ... if lookup_failed: ...` then `result.update(outcome="ok", reason="retarget", retarget=True)`); related scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh _heal_code_ref_route identity-check `rm -f "${code_ref_dir}/run-${code_ref_id}.json"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: lookup_failed is checked only when no candidate is found. A failed GET, an identity-check failure or a malformed cache for a newer run still lets an older linked run or an issue-linked fallback win with outcome=ok reason=retarget.
  WHY: This breaks the fail-closed requirement and can send the heal fix to the wrong branch. test_intake_code_ref_without_evidence_pack_gets_at_most_three_runs asserts the retarget even though run 603 was unreadable. Suggested fix: return partial/lookup_failed when lookup_failed is set, and pass --lookup-failed on identity-check drops.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:code_ref_run_eligible() path check; code_ref() scope check | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The run `path` is validated without removing the `@ref` suffix. `_REPO_PATH_RE` (line 547) rejects `@`, while lines 1494, 1539, 4805 and 9522 all remove the suffix first.
  WHY: Runs with a suffixed path are never eligible and never match the scope, so code-ref does nothing for them (fails closed).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:code_ref() `if candidate is None:` branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When both script_ref and lookup_failed apply, the reason is overwritten to lookup_failed while the body line comes from script_ref.
  WHY: The log line does not match where the body line came from. Cosmetic only.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:_heal_code_ref_route `mkdir -p "${code_ref_dir}" || return 0` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The early return leaves CODE_REF_OUTCOME/REASON at skipped/disabled and skips the decision over cached data.
  WHY: With the switch on, it logs `reason=disabled`, which is not in the agents.d/heal-code-ref.md vocabulary. Suggested fix: set partial/helper_failed.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Fail closed to today's target when validation or lookup fails, and log WORKFLOW_HEAL code_ref outcome=ok|skipped|partial reason=<r>." | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py code_ref() retarget decision; scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh _heal_code_ref_route identity-check drop branch | Evidence of absence: no lookup_failed check after a candidate is selected; the identity-mismatch branch does not pass --lookup-failed; the new test asserts retarget=main despite the failed 603 lookup | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "When P1 is off, make one GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id> per linked or issue-linked run, at most 3." | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh _heal_code_ref_route (P1-off branch) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py code_ref_requests | Evidence of absence: ids come only from select_linked_runs; agents.d/heal-code-ref.md says "issue-linked runs are not looked up with P1 off"; likely a deliberate narrowing to stay within budget | SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
